actual_scope: Exhibit one element of the order-3072 c=1 stabilizer, outside the group generated by H, g and t, that carries the pinned 8-dimensional (+1,+1) joint basis onto another joint space, and census every stabilizer element.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for a formal caller or certificate binding. PR #7019 computed the characteristic polynomial of one 8-dimensional c=1 joint eigenspace and left unconstructed any stabilizer element outside <H, g, t> carrying that basis onto another joint space. This package exhibits one such element and classifies the order-3072 stabilizer. It does not add a Lean binding.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result on the historical centre Gram. The selected conditional kappa remains 781451/250000000. The transporter explains why two joint spaces of the unique 32-dimensional c=1 character carry the same matrix of B. It does not replace the degree-881 one-slot minimal polynomial.
stop_rule: Stop once one explicit stabilizer element outside <H, g, t> is checked against the inherited basis, or once the order-3072 stabilizer has been fully classified. Do not compute a 216-by-216 nullity or the normalizer action on the 216-space.
evidence: verify.py rebuilds the signed affine stabilizer of sector 1, the inherited 8-dimensional basis, and the witness sigma=(0 3)(5 6) with all signs +1. Marker PASS_C1_JOINT_8_TRANSPORTER. The witness lands on the (+1,-1) space. The census fibers are 768, 768, 768, 768, with 2304 elements outside <H,g,t> carrying the basis onto a different joint space. Selected baseline returned PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY.
author: unpaidmoon
ai_assistance: Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. The assistant derived the witness and the census and checked the verifier. This is not an independent human or proof-kernel review.

open_questions.question: What is the image in GL(V) of the 768-element setwise stabilizer of this (+1,+1) joint space?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 704 of those elements lie outside <H, g, t> and still preserve V. A scalar image would mean they do not split V any further. This V is the chi joint space of PR #7019, not the 8-dimensional dihedral isotypic summand of the trivial-character 216-space.
open_questions.first_step: Restrict to the ordered basis one diagonal stabilizer element that is minus on all of L={0,3,4,7} and plus on the complement, and compare the resulting matrix with ±I.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package classifies where the basis is sent. It does not compute the matrix of a preserver on V, and it does not use the 216-space.
